_comment: Disagreements between breadth.py's textual oracle and Lain, each checked by hand against the source. 'oracle' means the oracle is wrong and Lain's answer is right. A disagreement that is not listed here counts against Lain.

reviewed.reason: self.map.get_mut(key) is HashMap::get_mut, not Table::get_mut
every occurrence is inside just-language strings or test macros (justfile source, S-expressions), not Rust calls
example code inside JSDoc comments
example code and prose inside JSDoc comments
rootCmd.Execute() is inside a raw-string Go program the test compiles, not test code
detail::check_signed_range<T>(...) is a real call; the oracle's name( pattern cannot see explicit template arguments
two overloads (a generic one the oracle's regex misses); InstanceBuilder calls the generic one, which the ambiguous name resolves to
to_hash.each_value(&block) is Hash#each_value
Array/String#include? calls, not the test helper's include?
request.preferred_type.params: a real call written without parentheses
default_reaction :deny: real class-body calls written without parentheses
.basicAuth(username:password:) there constructs an enum case of the same name
headers.makeIterator() is Array.makeIterator
self.responseSerializerDidComplete { ... }: real calls with a trailing closure and no parentheses
example code and prose inside a JSDoc comment
c.Flags().ArgsLenAtDash() calls pflag's FlagSet method, not Command.ArgsLenAtDash
defined twice (Maybe.Return<T> and Either.Return); the oracle's regex misses one, so the name is not unique
assert_equal 'Test', request.user_agent: a real call without parentheses
remap_extensions / base.remap_extensions: real calls without parentheses
.compression(compression) there constructs an enum case of the same name
self.map.into_values() is BTreeMap::into_values
self.0.italic() is the terminal-style library's method, not Style::italic
Vec/HashSet::extend calls, not Tree::extend
